title: The agent writes data, never the page

options.label: In the repo (.review/), answers local
options.act: Cards in <repo>/.review/ via CLI; answers in Projects/<slug>/
options.then: Keep cards in the repo's .review/ folder, written only through the CLI, with your answers in Switchboard's per-project folder.

options.label: All in Switchboard's app folder, nothing in the repo

why: The fix for the board I broke twice. The page is a fixed app; the agent only adds and updates cards through the CLI (switchboard review add, the way Flex's flex-review add works). The cards live in the project's repo (a .review/ folder), so they're versioned with the work and travel with it. Your answers stay local, in Switchboard's per-project folder beside terminals.yaml.
The CLI's shape is already proven by Flex: flex-review add --rec --why --basis --unsure --unsure-at --changed, settle, working, log. These become switchboard review add | settle | working | log.
Switchboard already keeps unknown config keys and watches project folders, so it can index every project's board.
